reuse.why: Applies the exclusion inside the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection used by all bulk actions, and in copyPreviousMonth's existing skip list, through one shared predicate.

duplication.why: The tag test exists once; only the notes join is added to both getBudgetData and getBulkBudgetCategories, following the tree's existing two-query split.

placement.why: The rule sits in budget/actions.ts in the shared category selection, next to the hidden/goal exclusions it joins.

scope.why: Only the budget actions module and one test.

maintainability.why: New bulk actions inherit the rule through getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth's separate path is the tree's pre-existing split and gets the same predicate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero, setLastMonthSpending and setNMonthAvg get the rule from getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth uses getBudgetData as before and calls isFixedGroupNote.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repetition is the notes join in two existing queries, written openly.

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts isFixedGroupNote decides the tag, applied in getBulkBudgetCategories (all bulk set actions) and copyPreviousMonth's skip list.
